target: Asymptotic order of the least number of origin rotations of closed periodic unit-scale strips covering every point of R^2.
hypotheses: Unit-length normals; rotations about the origin only; no translation, dilation or phase shift.
Closed strips and coverage of every point of the entire plane.
First-circle, central-disk and second-moment assertions have 0<epsilon<1/2.
accepted_conclusions: liminf as epsilon decreases to zero of epsilon N(epsilon) is at least pi/2; asymptotic factor-pi improvement over the cited 1/(2epsilon) baseline.
The central-disk test is equivalent to maximal cyclic axis gap <=2 arcsin(epsilon/(1-epsilon)); equally spaced axes are optimal for this disk only.
N(epsilon)=1 for epsilon>=1/2; credited N(epsilon)=3 for 1/3<=epsilon<1/2; N(epsilon)>=4 for 0<epsilon<1/3.
remaining_gap: No lower bound of larger asymptotic order, improved upper bound, matching estimates or exact small-epsilon covering formula is proved. The full asymptotic-order target remains unresolved by this work.
